items.description: Todo stats-tool-class: add a "tool" provenance class to stats.classify/CLASSES (tools/reverseapoc/stats.py) and progress.provenance_class/PROVENANCE_CLASSES/caption/rows (tools/progress.py) for landings whose Matched-By is "reverseapoc twins" or "reverseapoc lift" without the driver trailer; Flags-Approved-By stays an orthogonal flag; --min-unattended counts only unattended; verify the split against git and status.csv (expected at 8349c97b 187 unattended / 99 tool / 7 human-written; at HEAD +2 Sol unattended), measured independently; TDD; move the todo to completed with a Resolution note

Todo relocation-null-control: add a third nightly preflight control in driver.run_controls - the gold unit (src/ufo2p/u_000a34f0.c, func_000A3980) with the D_0012EFAC extern repointed to another undefined signed-char data symbol, so bytes and size match and only the relocation differs; it must exit 1 (MISMATCH) with bytes ok and reloc FAILED, else the night is refused; record it beside gold/null in the STARTED controls (keep older records valid) and in the stats environment line; TDD; move the todo to completed with a Resolution note

Todo harness-independent-pragma-check: refuse #pragma, _asm, __asm and _Pragma in landed C in the landing path every harness shares (gate before a unit lands, also gate --all), reusing hooks.asm_problem (no second copy; replace batch.py's _BANNED with it); include/common.h and include/watcom_compat.h keep the lax header rule; a test per harness shape (a Codex-arm driver landing whose unit carries #pragma aux is refused); run once over src/ and record the result; TDD; move the todo to completed with a Resolution note

Todo agy-search-web-guard: deny agy network/browser/MCP tools (search_web and every network tool in the init event's tool list) in driver.agy_settings; refuse a session whose init lists a network tool the settings do not deny; add an agy canary probe asking for a web search that must be denied; a denied network step stops only that arm like a denied write; first establish read-only how agy 1.5.11 can deny a tool (permission kinds, settings keys); TDD; move the todo to completed with a Resolution note once the code lands (the live canary is run by the coordinator)

Hand-off board threshold: new reverseapoc handoff --dry-run|--write [--json] (tools/reverseapoc/handoff.py + cli) proposing and writing config/handoff.csv rows (header exe,address,reason,retired_on,return_rule): retire a function with at least 24 attempts whose best percent did not rise over its last 9 attempts (3 passes); never a matched row; return automatically when the owner writes a hint for it in config/hints/<exe>.toml or when tooling aimed at its failure class lands (config/handoff-tooling.toml lists class and landed date); keep rows of other reasons untouched; TDD

Held-comparison rules in stats --compare: pair only picks both runs finished (a dropped or quota-cut arm enters a pair only on picks both arms finished), accept 2+ runs and apply a Holm correction across all run pairs, report raw and Holm-adjusted exact McNemar p; TDD

Three-shapes stop rule at 256 B and up (watcom-decomp skill via superpowers writing-skills with a RED/GREEN retrieval test by a fresh agent): at 256 B and up a new shape counts only when the attempt check's shape: line (blocks, branches) changes, at most 6 shapes; keep the 15-check budget; leave the rule under 256 B as is; keep session.STOP_RULES and tests/test_skill.py + tests/test_session.py in sync; branch only, merged by the coordinator after the old-rule held run

Boundary-fix input for functions.csv: add a committed validated config/<exe>/boundary-fixes.csv (split/merge rulings) that reverseapoc functions --write applies after reconcile, refusing matched rows, so suspected bad splits can be fixed through the generator; also put every current mechanics interior suspect row on config/handoff.csv with reason "suspected bad split" and return_rule "boundary fixed"; TDD
